headlines.title_en: PBOC net injects 100 billion yuan via outright reverse repos and government bond trading in September
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC released the liquidity injection situation for various central bank instruments in September 2026. In terms of central bank lending, the standing lending facility (SLF) recorded a net injection of RMB 200 million; the medium-term lending facility (MLF) recorded a net injection of RMB 200 billion, and pledged supplementary lending (PSL) recorded a net withdrawal of RMB 1.4 billion; in terms of open market operations, 7-day reverse repos recorded a net withdrawal of RMB 86 billion, and outright outright outright purchases of government bonds recorded a net injection of RMB 100 billion.

headlines.title: 欧盟拟对能源企业征收暴利税，应对伊朗战争引发的能源价格冲击
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月9日讯，据外媒报道，随着冬季临近，欧洲各国政府正努力寻找缓解能源价格冲击的方法。欧盟委员会将评估在整个欧盟范围内对能源企业超额利润征税的潜在影响，以减轻消费者和企业的负担。据知情人士透露，欧盟委员会周五在卢森堡举行的财政部长会议上表示，将研究实施欧盟统一能源暴利税的可行性，并考虑利用相关税收收入为民众提供救济。此前，包括德国在内的多个欧盟成员国已呼吁研究这一措施。然而，欧盟气候事务委员沃普克·胡克斯特拉表示，该措施最终筹集的资金远低于最初预计的500亿欧元，并引发了多起法律诉讼，欧盟至今仍在处理相关案件。胡克斯特拉周五抵达财政部长会议现场时

headlines.title_en: EU plans windfall tax on energy companies to counter energy price shock from Iran war
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 9 - According to foreign media reports, as winter approaches, European governments are working hard to find ways to ease the energy price shock. The European Commission will assess the potential impact of taxing excess profits of energy companies across the entire EU, in order to reduce the burden on consumers and businesses. According to people familiar with the matter, the European Commission said at a meeting of finance ministers held in Luxembourg on Friday that it would study the feasibility of implementing an EU-wide energy windfall tax and consider using the related tax revenue to provide relief to the public. Previously, multiple EU member states, including Germany, had called for studying this measure. However, EU Climate Commissioner Wopke Hoekstra said that the measure ultimately raised far less than the initially estimated 50 billion euros and triggered multiple legal proceedings, with the EU still handling related cases to date. Hoekstra said on Friday upon arriving at the venue of the finance ministers' meeting.

headlines.title: 中国证监会：删除现行关于发起式基金成立满3年规模不足2亿元需终止基金合同的规定
headlines.summary: 中国证监会10月9日宣布，就《公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法（征求意见稿）》及配套规则公开征求意见。征求意见稿提出，完善“迷你基金”监管要求，要求基金管理人如选择持续运作“迷你基金”的，需承担基金运作的固定费用成本，并要求建立基金产品规模过低的强制退出机制，切实保护持有人利益。优化发起式基金退出要求，删除现行关于发起式基金成立满3年规模不足2亿元需终止基金合同的规定。

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Remove existing rule requiring termination of fund contracts for initiated funds that have been established for 3 years with assets under 200 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC announced on October 9 that it is publicly soliciting comments on the Measures for the Operation and Management of Publicly Offered Securities Investment Funds (Draft for Comment) and supporting rules. The draft for comment proposes improving regulatory requirements for "mini funds," requiring fund managers that choose to continue operating "mini funds" to bear the fixed costs of fund operation, and requiring the establishment of a mandatory exit mechanism for fund products whose scale is too low, so as to effectively protect the interests of holders. It also optimizes the exit requirements for sponsored funds and deletes the current provision that a sponsored fund must terminate its fund contract if its scale is less than RMB 200 million after three years since establishment.

headlines.title: 权益类基金成立门槛拟降至5000万元
headlines.summary: 中国证监会10月9日宣布，就《公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法（征求意见稿）》及配套规则公开征求意见。征求意见稿支持权益类基金发展，拟将权益类基金、基金中基金（FOF）等产品的成立门槛，从规模2亿元、份额2亿份，分别降至5000万元、5000万份，固收类基金成立门槛维持不变。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Minimum threshold for establishing equity funds proposed to be lowered to 50 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC announced on October 9 that it is publicly soliciting comments on the Measures for the Operation and Management of Publicly Offered Securities Investment Funds (Draft for Comment) and supporting rules. The draft for comment supports the development of equity funds and proposes lowering the establishment thresholds for products such as equity funds and funds of funds (FOFs) from RMB 200 million and 200 million units to RMB 50 million and 50 million units, respectively, while the establishment threshold for fixed-income funds remains unchanged. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Non-sector-theme funds should adhere to the principle of diversified investment and must not concentrate investment in a single industry or theme
headlines.summary_en: In response to the problem of "broad-based selection with narrow investment" in all-market stock-selection funds, the Operation Measures require that non-sector-theme funds adhere to the principle of diversified investment and not concentrate investment in a single industry or theme. If a product is positioned as all-market stock selection, it should make relatively diversified allocations according to its positioning and cannot in substance evolve into a single-track fund.

headlines.title: 公募基金运作办法征求意见：加强投资风格稳定性管理，强化业绩比较基准约束作用
headlines.summary: 中国证监会就《公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法（征求意见稿）》及配套规则公开征求意见。《管理办法》一是压实基金管理人投资运作主体责任，要求基金管理人强化基金产品的逆周期布局管理，坚持理性审慎投资，健全促进基金稳定运作的风险管理机制。二是加强投资风格稳定性管理，强化业绩比较基准约束作用，要求行业主题基金清晰界定基金名称所示投资方向、非行业主题基金坚持分散投资原则。

headlines.title_en: Public fund operation measures open for comment: Strengthen management of investment style stability and reinforce the constraining role of performance benchmarks
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC is publicly soliciting comments on the Measures for the Operation and Management of Publicly Offered Securities Investment Funds (Draft for Comment) and supporting rules. First, the Management Measures consolidate the primary responsibility of fund managers for investment operations, requiring fund managers to strengthen countercyclical layout management of fund products, adhere to rational and prudent investment, and improve risk management mechanisms that promote stable fund operation. Second, they strengthen management of investment style stability and the constraining role of performance benchmarks, requiring sector-theme funds to clearly define the investment direction indicated by the fund name, and non-sector-theme funds to adhere to the principle of diversified investment.

headlines.summary_en: According to CICC, recently CICC Chairman and Chairman of the Management Committee Chen Liang met with Canada Pension Plan Investment Board President and Chief Executive Officer John Graham, and the two sides held in-depth exchanges on topics such as deepening cross-border capital market cooperation and continuously expanding the Chinese market.

headlines.title: 商务部：中欧双方将继续探讨在世贸组织规则框架下，降低部分商品关税的可能性
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月9日讯，商务部发布中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会联合声明。双方将继续探讨在世贸组织规则框架下，降低部分商品关税的可能性。双方将继续在贸易监测机制项下加强沟通合作，并进一步积极发挥对话机制作用，增进相互理解。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China and the EU will continue to explore the possibility of reducing tariffs on certain goods under the WTO rules framework
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 9 - The Ministry of Commerce issued a joint statement of the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism. The two sides will continue to explore the possibility of reducing tariffs on some goods within the framework of WTO rules. The two sides will continue to strengthen communication and cooperation under the trade monitoring mechanism and further actively leverage the role of the dialogue mechanism to enhance mutual understanding.

headlines.title_en: List of consensus outcomes from the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism: Both sides agree on the importance of enhancing the predictability and stability of global industrial and supply chains
headlines.summary_en: List of outcomes and consensus of the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism: Both sides agree on the importance of enhancing the predictability and stability of global industrial and supply chains. China is willing to continue facilitating the approval of export licenses for rare earths and permanent magnets to the EU through the "green channel" mechanism. headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China is willing to continue facilitating licensing approvals for rare earth and permanent magnet exports to the EU through the green channel mechanism
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 9 - The Ministry of Commerce issued a joint statement of the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism. Both sides agree on the importance of enhancing the predictability and stability of global industrial and supply chains. China is willing to continue facilitating the approval of export licenses for rare earths and permanent magnets to the EU through the "green channel" mechanism. The EU will continue to work with member states to facilitate solutions to key licensing cases involving China in dual-use fields.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai International Energy Exchange: Adjusts price limits and trading margin ratios for crude oil and low-sulfur fuel oil futures contracts
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai International Energy Exchange: After study and decision, starting from the close of settlement on Monday, October 12, 2026, the price limits and trading margin ratios are adjusted as follows: the price limits for crude oil futures contracts SC2612 and SC2701, and low-sulfur fuel oil futures contracts LU2612 and LU2701 are 16%, the trading margin ratio for hedging positions is 17%, and the trading margin ratio for ordinary positions is 18%.

headlines.title: 中共中央、国务院：将符合国家战略需求的企业研发项目按程序上升为国家项目
headlines.summary: 中共中央、国务院印发《关于发展新质生产力的意见》。其中指出，强化企业科技创新主体地位。加强普惠激励政策供给，建立企业研发准备金制度，强化企业科技投入主导作用。鼓励科技型中小企业加大研发投入，提高企业研发费用加计扣除比例。将符合国家战略需求的企业研发项目按程序上升为国家项目，鼓励企业牵头国家科技任务，支持有能力的民营企业牵头承担国家重大技术攻关任务。建立用户考核评价成果的机制，强化企业成果转化主体地位。健全国有企业推进原始创新制度安排。支持专精特新中小企业发展。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council: R&D projects of enterprises that meet national strategic needs will be elevated to national projects through due procedures
headlines.summary_en: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council issued the "Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces." It states that the dominant role of enterprises in scientific and technological innovation should be strengthened. The supply of inclusive incentive policies should be increased, a enterprise R&D reserve fund system should be established, and enterprises' leading role in scientific and technological investment should be strengthened. Technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises should be encouraged to increase R&D investment, and the proportion of superdeduction for enterprise R&D expenses should be raised. Enterprise R&D projects that meet national strategic needs should be elevated to national projects according to procedures, enterprises should be encouraged to lead national science and technology tasks, and capable private enterprises should be supported in leading major national technological breakthrough tasks. A mechanism for assessing and evaluating outcomes by users should be established, and enterprises' dominant role in transforming outcomes should be strengthened. The institutional arrangements for state-owned enterprises to promote original innovation should be improved. Specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises should be supported in their development. (Xinhua News Agency)
